title: Bel-Ibni
summary: King of Babylon installed by Sennacherib.
description: King of Babylon. In Griffith & White’s Table 2 (Reply to Beckman, Part 2), Sennacherib installs him in 703 BC; 702 BC is his first year; in his third year (700 BC) Sennacherib replaces him with his own son. Person record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman (OSF project 5b64m) on 2026-11-13.

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (Tier 2, CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): installed 703 BC (first year 702; third year 700)). No tier 1–4 birth year.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, Table 2, rows 703–700, p. 42
reign.note: Replaced in his third year by Sennacherib’s son.
